notes.title: 💗🐧 & 🍎 Linux and macOS X support is now finally here!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35150713/885ad810253b0402e55840a53c4d49f4d3c5c369.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35150713/adab8c898fd16337b79625f02dc066ce738c8ddc.png[/img][/url]

I've finally got out of my basement and ported Super Web Kittens to [b]macOS X[/b] and [b]Linux[/b]! (tested on the latest version of Ubuntu)

Steam will automatically download the version you need so you don't have to worry about your operating system. Just have fun and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game is now available for purchase!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35150713/7c7d11a044941f5f7ad9cf6bce5bbe7dd527ca19.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35150713/53dab7c35b834fed92c2efc5352b7c0302549df7.jpg[/img][/url]
It was a lot of fun to make this game, despite of all difficulties.
I hope you will like it [i](the game, not the difficulties...)[/i] and also have a lot of fun with it!

[b]Super Web Kittens: Act I[/b] is now available for purchase with a [b]30% discount[/b]!

[b]If you have a problem[/b] with the game or found a bug, please, PM me or send a message to one of my e-mails, listed on the official website and Steam Support:
https://www.superwebkittens.com/contact

[b]If you want to share your opinion[/b] about the game, you can leave a review or create a topic on the special community subforum:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1058840/discussions/1/

Sincerely yours,
Kuno Hoshiko.

notes.title: Release date moved
notes.notes:
Release date was moved to the 26th of July because I am stupid and underestimated game review time. Unfortunately, there is no option to release game on the weekends.

Remember to add game to your wishlist (that big green button!) so you won't miss the new release date!

Sorry!
